outOfDenominator.reason: `.indexOn` is a query-index directive, not an access-control construct: it tells the database which child keys to index for ordering and filtering, and produces no ALLOW/DENY verdict of its own. The verified axis is evidenced by captured allow/deny verdicts, so no production authorization capture can ever verify it and leaving it in the denominator would permanently depress the number with work that cannot exist. Its deploy/round-trip through the rules JSON IS production-proven, by the rtdb-rules-json-roundtrip observation.
